Subject: Sync: Algorithmic Challenge — scheduling & platform fallback (Alyssa Tran)

Hi all —

We have an incoming mid-stage technical screen for Alyssa (SWE II candidate) and I wanted to lock down the logistics and fallback plan. Proposed details below; please confirm availability or suggest swaps by EOD PDT.

- Window: Tue May 25, 2027 — 11:00–11:45 PT (45m coding + 15m buffer)
- Panel: Kimberly (primary interviewer) + Marcus (overflow/debrief)
- Platform primary: Redwood CoderPad (link below) — secondary: Zoom + shared Gitpod workspace if Pad has issues

Attachments: Alyssa_Tran_Resume.pdf, alg-challenge-v2.md (short problem & grader notes)

Backup plan if CoderPad is flaky:
1) Start on Zoom and paste problem into Gitpod for live coding; candidate will share a link.
2) If candidate experiences latency, we switch to a take-home style: 60 minutes to submit a gist and then 20 minutes debrief.

Marcus — can you host the Zoom room and provide a dial-in if necessary?
Kimberly — can you review the problem in the attached `alg-challenge-v2.md` and flag any changes to difficulty or language constraints by tomorrow noon?

Alyssa — welcome! If the proposed time works, reply and I'll send calendar invites + the coderpad link. If you need different windows, suggest two alternatives.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Talent Operations (Hiring Ops)
Redwood Inference

Thanks — 11:00–11:45 PT on Tue the 25th works for me. Reviewed `alg-challenge-v2.md` quickly:
- Problem difficulty: solid for SWE II.
- Language constraints: allow Python/TypeScript/Go. Add a note to accept pseudocode for edge-case discussion.
- Grading rubric: please include time/space expectations and a few targeted follow-ups.

I'll prepare the rubric bullets in a short doc (will share before the interview).

One question: do we want to include the candidate's public GitHub in the CV link or avoid external browsing? I typically avoid live external site checks during the screen to keep it focused.
